title: Consecutive integers free of certain prime factors
summary: Let $n_k$ denote the least integer $n>2k$ such that $(n-k)(n-k+1)\cdots(n-1)$ is not divisible by any prime in the interval $(k,2k)$. Confirming a conjecture of Erdős, we prove that, for all sufficiently large $k$, $$ n_k > e^{\frac{\log^2 k}{20 \log \log k}}. $$
